scripts.app:install: pnpm build && pnpm registry:build && node scripts/install-registry-app.mjs && pnpm --filter @openmirai/calculator-web routes:generate
scripts.build:site: pnpm app:install && pnpm --filter @openmirai/calculator-web build && node scripts/prepare-site.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm app:install && pnpm --filter @openmirai/calculator-core test && pnpm --filter @openmirai/calculator-web test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm app:install && pnpm --filter @openmirai/calculator-core test:coverage && pnpm --filter @openmirai/calculator-web test:coverage
scripts.typecheck: pnpm app:install && pnpm --filter @openmirai/calculator-core typecheck && pnpm --filter @openmirai/calculator-registry-source typecheck && pnpm --filter @openmirai/calculator-web typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm build && pnpm publint && pnpm registry:build
scripts.release:check: pnpm check && pnpm smoke:registry && pnpm smoke:package
